data.narrative:
Science Corporation is a Series B biotech company founded by Max Hodak that has raised $230M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 4 primary private peers in the Biotech & Health sector at the same or adjacent stage (Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B, Chai Discovery at $3.8B, New Limit at $3.1B, and Eikon Therapeutics at $539M), supplemented by 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) with a median price-to-sales multiple of 6.2x.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $230M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $437M. The peer-median method anchors to the $3.5B median valuation across the 4 same-sector peers, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring is not applicable because the target's revenue is not disclosed. 

These two methods yield a triangulated valuation range of $371M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.9B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Science Corporation tracks toward the lower-stage profile of Eikon Therapeutics or the later-stage valuations of the Series C cohort. Key uncertainties include pipeline advancement, IP strength, and capital efficiency relative to peers.
